exampleEn: I had to call him out for his rude behavior at the meeting.
exampleKo: 회의에서 그의 무례한 행동을 지적할 수 밖에 없었다.
gameExamples: It's important to call someone out when they spread misinformation.
During the discussion, she decided to call someone out for their unfair accusations.
He was brave enough to call someone out on their lack of effort in the project.
